description: Canonical append-only rollout ledger for the FAIR2026 Hybrid A2C-APF component evaluation. One row = one evaluation rollout. Regenerated from the immutable episode_audit.csv (canonical, steps5000000 runs only). The single non-canonical smoke run 'H0_A2C_map-random-01_seed101_steps64' is excluded.

fields.controller_id: string, one of H0,H1,H2 (H4 is a diagnostic, not a controller)
fields.map_hash: string, sha256 of built map geometry (from unit run JSON map_sha256)
fields.training_run_id: string, per (map, training_seed_label) independently trained model id (H2: nominal label only, non-learned)
fields.model_artifact_path: string, relative path to checkpoint zip (empty for H2 non-learned / evaluation-only reuse noted)
fields.model_sha256: string, checkpoint_sha256 from unit run JSON (empty if non-learned)
fields.numerical_episode_seed: int, evaluation_base_seed + episode_index (actual seed passed to env.reset)
fields.reset_seed: int, equals numerical_episode_seed (single env np_random seeds reset)
fields.wind_seed: int, equals numerical_episode_seed (WindModel shares env np_random)
fields.is_duplicate_numerical_seed: bool, true if numerical_episode_seed repeats within the same unit (seed-window overlap)
fields.minimum_signed_clearance_m: float, nearest AABB surface clearance (negative if inside)
fields.efficiency: float in (0,1] for successful rollouts; empty/NA for failures
fields.trajectory_artifact_path: string, relative path to per-episode npz
fields.trajectory_sha256: string, sha256 of npz (from unit SHA256SUMS)
fields.source_commit: string, git HEAD at audit time
fields.created_at_utc: string, ISO-8601 UTC ledger build time
